standard-dialogue.npc: What are yooo interrupting me for? Can't you see I'm working here?

standard-dialogue-successfully-stealing-.npc: Moo, what do yoooou think you're doing?

standard-dialogue-successfully-stealing-.player: Err... Nothing. Just checking that your cowbell was working. Don't want you to get lost!

standard-dialogue-successfully-stealing-.npc: How exactly am I going to get lost when I'm tied down? What were yooo really doing?

standard-dialogue-successfully-stealing-.player: I don't think you'll believe me.

standard-dialogue-successfully-stealing-.npc: I'm a talking cow, I'll believe almost anything.

standard-dialogue-successfully-stealing-.player: Fine. I need the bell to trick some penguins into helping me get into their secret lair.

standard-dialogue-successfully-stealing-.npc: Well why didn't you say so? I've got a ton of these things. Go ahead and take the bell.

standard-dialogue-failing-to-steal-the-c.text: The cow kicks you and stuns you
